hookups.source: ReserveAmerica per-site catalog for parkId 880429 (20 Full-Hookup sites list 50-amp, water and sewer; 46 Modern Electric list 50-amp, 7 list 30-amp) + https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/lackawanna-state-park/stay ('forested sites with electric hook-ups'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: 84 RV campsites on the booking site (53 Modern Electric, 20 Full-Hookup in the Ledges loop, 11 Modern Non-Electric) besides 17 walk-to tent sites, 3 cottages, 2 yurts and group tenting. Max vehicle lengths run 10 to 45 ft on back-in sites (mostly 30); the five Ledges pull-throughs take 45 to 70 ft. About 58 sites take 23 ft or more.

sites.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/lackawanna-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880429 (site list and each site's details page: Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry), read 2026-10-20

facilities.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/lackawanna-state-park/stay ('Campground shower houses provide warm showers and flush toilets. A sanitary dump station is near the campground entrance.'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Campsites can be booked for the same day and up to 11 months ahead (ReserveAmerica booking window). Maximum camping period 14 consecutive days in the summer season, 21 in the off-season.

booking.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/lackawanna-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880429 ('Full-Hookup ... Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 11 Month(s) in advance', same for Modern Electric and Non-Electric) + https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/lackawanna-state-park/stay ('The maximum camping period is 14 consecutive days in the summer season and 21 consecutive days in the off-season'), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed the inherited reservable/ReserveAmerica/11-month window/14-night summer max for this park, and the mid-April to mid-October season (already manual). Added 50-amp electric with water+sewer (20 Full-Hookup sites), 84 RV sites to 70 ft (pull-throughs), showers/flush toilets/dump. Not stated for this park: the Saturday two-night minimum, noon cutoff, walk-up policy. Fees left at the statewide table. Booking site lists sites 'Greater than 300 feet' from water, consistent with not waterfront.
